title: Inquiry about the release timeline and features for axum 0.9.0

comments.body:
There isn't any set timeline. We'd like to do it soon, but no promises and it could mean pretty much anything.

There is a changelog on the main branch though some latest merged changes are only in git commit messages. So those are the two place I'd advise you to look if you want to know.

If you don't mind me asking back, what exactly are you trying to solve or find out? Are you worried there would be a lot of breaking changes any day or what are you trying to plan around the releases?
